name: Brrawghh
doc: Brrawghh! (Gerogero's and Gunblade's enemy attack): the master and the main task - the spit tubes from the caster's mouth to the target, the spit, drip and splat sprites, the splash layouts, the layout at the target, the sound; the action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag289_brrawghh.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The spit tubes from the caster's mouth to the target, the spit, drip and splat sprites, the splash layouts, the layout at the target, the sound; the action result at 0xF

params.label: Splash
params.doc: The prim-model layout splash (its models' animation)

params.label: Target
params.doc: The prim-model layout target (its models' animation)

params.label: Drip
params.doc: The sprite sequence drip (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Splat
params.doc: The sprite sequence splat (a flipbook of 12 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Spit
params.doc: The sprite sequence spit (a flipbook of 12 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Tube a model
params.doc: The prim model tube a (a mesh of 164 vertices, 80 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Tube b model
params.doc: The prim model tube b (a mesh of 164 vertices, 80 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
